notes.title: Gallery added, issues fixed, recommendation to start a new game
notes.notes:
Attention!
Highly recommended to start a new game!
What's new:
-Added gallery. The gallery opens as you pass through. Almost every scene in the gallery is a set of images following each other at 2 sec intervals.
-Fixed day and night switching logic
-Little update of English and Russian language, corrected errors and stylistics
-The image of the button to call the game screen with girls' stats now does not overlap the game scenes (the button disappears)
-Small corrections

notes.notes: Small bugs fixed in code and eng translation
